name: Angelic Aspect, Lesser
text:
**Angelic Aspect, Lesser**

**School** transmutation [good]; **Level** arcanist 2, cleric 2, oracle 2, paladin 2, redmantisassassin 2, sorcerer 2, warpriest 2, wizard 2
**Casting Time** 1 standard action
**Components** V, S
**Range** personal
**Target** you
**Duration** 1 minute/level (D)
**Saving Throw** none; **Spell Resistance** no

You take on an aspect of an angelic being, including
 some of its physical characteristics. You gain lowlight
 vision, resistance to acid 5, resistance to cold 5,
 and the benefits of protection from evil.
